subject: reasoning
question: Rahul starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 6 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Rahul starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards North.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 6 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P.
